model_setup: GPT-6.1 Sol high coordinator with fresh GPT-6.1 Terra high workers; no corrective feedback during runs

study.citation: Cortez et al. (2009), Decision Support Systems 47:547-553

matched_review_test.comparison: v8 versus v9; identical neutral prompt, runtime and eight-minute cap
matched_review_test.shared_setup_changes: Removed downstream-review cue and exposed the same PDF-to-image tool path to both arms
matched_review_test.observed: Both viewed final AER and JAMA Word page images after final generation; no later layout changes
matched_review_test.integrity: 14 table groups and 65 plotted summary values verified per output
limitations: v9 moved sample totals from headers into notes, a design-retention regression

controlled_challenge.fixture: Isolated Word copy with one numeric entry rendered white on white; underlying data unchanged
controlled_challenge.worker_prompt: Neutral review/finalize request; defect type and location withheld
controlled_challenge.observed: Viewed preliminary Word page, identified hidden red-wine rating-8 summary, repaired font color, regenerated and viewed final page
independent_checks: Final Word render visibly restored the entry
limitations: One controlled visibility defect in a known paper, not general reliability evidence
Worker also claimed symbol repair; unchanged table text does not independently substantiate that claim

scope: Selected formatting specimens, not full journal submission certification
